description: Skill-owned Objective-C and compile-verified Swift units with ordered recipes. Objective-C public declarations remain signature truth.

units.scenario: Verify the license and obtain a flag-configured singleton.
units.ownership: The app owns the NvsStreamingContext singleton returned by sharedInstanceWithFlags:; it is process-wide and must not be released by the caller. The SDK license file must stay readable for the singleton's lifetime.
units.cleanup: Do not release the singleton. Release the license path string after verification. The singleton is torn down only on process exit; never call removeTimeline: on a context you did not create.

units.scenario: Create an aligned Timeline within Context capacity.
guards: pixel area within singleton flag capacity
failure: return nil without using child objects
units.ownership: The NvsStreamingContext singleton owns the NvsTimeline it creates; the caller holds a non-owning reference and must release it via removeTimeline: before the context deallocates.
units.cleanup: Call removeTimeline: on the context, then nil out the local timeline reference. Do not mutate the timeline after compile_started.

units.scenario: Append a Photos asset by local identifier.
units.ownership: The NvsVideoTrack (owned by the timeline) owns the appended NvsVideoClip; the caller holds a non-owning reference for subsequent clip configuration.
units.cleanup: No explicit release for the clip; removing the track or timeline disposes it. Nil out the local clip reference after configuration.

units.scenario: Connect a Timeline to an attached, non-empty LiveWindow after view layout and before preview operations.
units.ownership: The NvsStreamingContext owns the preview connection to the NvsLiveWindow; the LiveWindow view itself is owned by the UIViewController.
units.cleanup: Disconnect by stopping playback / connecting nil before the LiveWindow leaves the view hierarchy; release the LiveWindow view in the view controller dealloc.

units.scenario: Start a custom-height Timeline compile with required breakpoint-continuation cache configuration.
guards: set both required breakpoint-continuation configuration entries
clear stale cache before a non-resume compile
handle delegate and clear cache after final outcomes
units.ownership: The NvsStreamingContext owns the running compile. The caller owns both outputPath and cachePath; both must remain stable across a background-interrupted resume.
units.cleanup: Clear stale cache before a non-resume compile. Retain cache only for a background cancellation that will resume. Remove cache after final success, final failure, user cancellation, or start/restart failure. Do not mutate the timeline during compile.

units.scenario: Remove an editor-owned Timeline after stopping conflicts.
units.ownership: This unit returns an EDITOR_OWNED timeline to the context for disposal; ownership is transferred back to the context only transiently for removal.
units.cleanup: After removeTimeline: returns YES, nil out the local timeline reference. Never reuse the disposed timeline object.
units.code:
if (timeline == nil) { return YES; }
return [context removeTimeline:timeline];

units.scenario: Verify the license and obtain the flag-configured singleton through compiled Swift imports.
units.ownership: The app owns the NvsStreamingContext singleton returned by sharedInstance(withFlags:); it is process-wide and must not be released by the caller. The SDK license file must stay readable for the singleton's lifetime.
units.cleanup: Do not release the singleton. Release the license path string after verification. The singleton is torn down only on process exit.
units.code:
guard NvsStreamingContext.verifySdkLicenseFile(licensePath) else { return nil }
return NvsStreamingContext.sharedInstance(withFlags: flags)

units.scenario: Create an aligned Timeline within Context capacity through compiled Swift imports.

failure: return nil without using child objects

units.cleanup: Call context.remove(timeline), then nil out the local timeline reference. Do not mutate the timeline after compile_started.

units.scenario: Append a Photos asset local identifier through compiled Swift imports.
units.ownership: The NvsVideoTrack (owned by the timeline) owns the appended NvsVideoClip; the caller holds a non-owning reference for subsequent clip configuration.
units.cleanup: No explicit release for the clip; removing the track or timeline disposes it. Nil out the local clip reference after configuration.
units.code:
guard !identifier.isEmpty else { return nil }
return track.appendClip(identifier)

units.scenario: Connect an attached, laid-out LiveWindow through compiled Swift imports.
guards: LiveWindow belongs to a visible window
units.ownership: The NvsStreamingContext owns the preview connection to the NvsLiveWindow; the LiveWindow view itself is owned by the UIViewController.
units.cleanup: Disconnect by stopping playback before the LiveWindow leaves the view hierarchy; release the LiveWindow view in the view controller dealloc.
units.code:
guard liveWindow.window != nil, !liveWindow.bounds.isEmpty else { return false }
return context.connect(timeline, with: liveWindow)
